chakana: The heart of the city around the Root, where the Beanstalk meets the ground at the Plaza del Cielo. Corporate towers, the spaceport trade and the densest crowds in New Angeles.
base-de-cayambe: The rough port town that serves the Beanstalk, in the foothills of Volcán Cayambe. Freight, cheap housing, markets and little corporate presence.
rutherford: The entertainment district, a riot of neon, clubs, casinos and media. NBN and a hundred smaller corps keep towers among the noise.
esmeraldas: The northernmost district, a working- and middle-class sprawl of condo rows on a numbered grid. Second best at nearly everything, and proud of its sports, food and music.
nihongai: Little Nippon, a rich and orderly Jinteki company town of green-walled arcologies, gardens and a low corporate campus. New Akiba adds one hot neon pocket on the coast.
laguna-velasco: The government district round the Velasco Ibarra reservoir. Civic arcologies on wide lawns, lakefront mansions, and one of the worst undercities in the city.
manta: Over 100 km of resort coast and the second port, home of Haas-Bioroid. The party Strip runs along the surf, with office towers and warehouses behind it.
rabotgorod: The Workers' City, now Robot City. An endless grid of Soviet-model barracks blocks that store androids and unemployed humans.
la-costa: The city's breadbasket and its least populated district. Fields, orchards and wetlands broken by agroplex towers, with canneries and fish farms on the coast.
quinde: The factory floor of New Angeles. Sheds, stacks, fusion plants and container tenements on a flat coastal plain, with strong unions on the docks.
guayaquil: The old Ecuadorian metropolis, the most populous district and the one run by orgcrime. Dead proto-arcologies in Antiguo, brighter layered towers in Nuevo.
